name: io.github.OxygenBubbles/freeagent-mcp-server
description: MCP server for FreeAgent accounting — bank reconciliation, expenses, mileage claims and receipt management. Automates categorising transactions, attaching receipts, creating expense claims and logging business mileage.

environmentVariables.name: FREEAGENT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: FreeAgent OAuth app client ID (from dev.freeagent.com)

environmentVariables.name: VENDOR_CATEGORIES
environmentVariables.description: JSON map of vendor name to FreeAgent category URL (extends built-in mappings)

environmentVariables.name: ORS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouteService API key for driving distance calculation

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Maps API key (alternative to ORS for distance calculation)
